I'm pro-gun in the hands of the right people, for a few reasons:
1. Guns don't kill people. People do. And bears. Nasty fuckers.
2. If guns are outlawed, only outlaws will have guns, and the people who just want to protect themselves and turn into outlaws when the popos find out they're packing heat
3. I'm a supporter of castle law, and self-defense rights.
4. If we let them take our guns, what's to stop them from taking more of our rights?

Funny thing is I have never disagreed with someones reasons so much while at the same time totally agreeing with their conclusion. Your bullet points sound like they were ripped out of the front page of the NRA handbook.

1) Guns absolutely kill people. Ignoring increased murder and suicide rates by people who own guns, there are still accidental misfires and kids accidentally killing other kids. 2) What does this even mean? If I just want to shot some heroin, do I become an outlaw just because I buy some heroin? Absolutely. Should I? Maybe not. But I am still breaking the law.
3) Totally agree with you here. 4) Who is them? The government? Or the people who agree that we should make guns illegal. If we, as a nation, agree, with a majority, that something written into our constitution is wrong, we can absolutely change it. And we have. Prohibition for example. Repealing prohibition was generally seen as a move in the right direction, and certainly did not lead to the destruction of America.

All that said, I still totally agree with you. I think responsible adults should be able to make a decision about whether or not they want to own a gun. I agree that people should have a right to defend their house. I feel like it is healthy to have the government at least a little scared of the people they govern. I am all for hunting despite not doing myself. Also guns are fun. They are fun to shoot, they are fun to talk about, they are fun to make video games out off.

They are also dangerous as hell. And to ignore the fact that they are is dangerous as well. Murder rates go up, suicide rates go up. Guns in households are more likely to accidentally kill someone you love versus any home intruder. Guns increase death rates. Guns fall into the wrong hands. Public carry laws can lead to confusion, panic and accidental death. Guns are dangerous. But so are cars. I don't think cars should be made illegal either. But I do think that there should be discussions about what sort of guns you can buy, about who can buy guns, about whether or not they belong in public, and at what point you can tell someone they can no longer own or operate them.

Garlic Parmesan Wings:

1/2 C Butter 1/4 C Extra Virgin Olive Oil 1 tsp Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp onion salt
1/4 tsp ground black pepper 1 pkg chicken wings

Fry wings 10 minutes until golden. Line baking sheet w/ aluminum foil. Preheat oven to 350F. Finish wings in oven 25-40 minutes.

Place butter and oil in small pan. Melt Butter. WHen butter is melted add garlic, onion and pepper. Stir as needed. Reduce to low and keep warm.

Add parmesan to taste to sauce. Place wings in bowl and add sauce. Toss wings to cover. Plate and garnish with remaining sauce, parsley and parmesan.

Serve and enjoy.
